items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: There was about ten trombone players. Little Shorty, Little Stump...

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard about it. I missed him. I didn't get to hear him. What about Big Green, too? Because I hear so much about him. Did you hear him?
Yes. Great trombone player. Pretty trombone player. There was about ten trombone players. Little Shorty, Little Stump...
